In addition to a pleasant group of colleagues, you can count on a gross salary of €17.88 per hour (this includes 8.75% shift allowance) excellent secondary employment conditions. - Free access to E-learning platform Manpower Academy 
    
- Full-time/ job of 40 hours a week 
    
- Temporary employment contract with Manpower

    - In possession of a valid reach truck certificate
    
- At least one year of work experience as a reach truck driver, warehouse employee, order picker or similar
    
- A good command of the Dutch language is required so that you can have basic conversations and maintain email contact.
    
- Knowledge of the English language due to communication with colleagues and customers

Are you the new reach truck driver that our client is looking for? Then don't hesitate and apply today! Manpower will contact you within two working days.
